'''Cinder Shard''' is a [[:Category:Resources|resource]] that can be obtained by mining [[Mining#Mining Nodes|Cinder Shard nodes]] or obtained from [[Volcano Dungeon#Treasure|Common or Rare Chests]], [[Magma Sprite]]s, [[Magma Sparker]]s, [[Magma Duggy|Magma Duggies]], or [[False Magma Cap]]s in the [[Volcano Dungeon]]. It can also be acquired from a [[Stingray]] [[Fish Pond]] with a population of at least 7, or found in Skull Cavern [[Skull Cavern#Treasure Rooms|treasure rooms]] after the [[Volcano Dungeon#Floor 10|Volcano Shortcut]] has been unlocked.

==Forging==
{{Main article|Forge}}
Cinder Shards are used in the [[Forge]] to combine rings, enchant tools, and forge melee weapons with gemstones. 20 Cinder Shards are used to combine two rings, apply a random enchantment to a tool or weapon, or add a [[Galaxy Soul]] to a Galaxy weapon, while 10/15/20 are used to forge a tool for the first, second, and third time, respectively.

==Tailoring==
It is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create {{Name|Sunglasses|class=inline}}. It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as an orange dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]].

==Quests==
7 Cinder Shards are requested by [[Stingray]] in a [[Fish Pond#Quests|Fish Pond quest]] to increase the capacity of the pond from 3 to 5.
